requirement.contract: One rolling terminal card; passive idle counters require changed visible output, clocks remain readable, input delivery stays independent.
cases: https terminal fills one large card while controls stay within the small streaming field
sdk terminal fills one large card while controls stay within the small streaming field
runtime observation does not claim success from idle, silence or completed-looking screen text
a retired observation from a stale tick snapshot cannot read or recreate its card
a replacement during read never publishes the new program screen
revocation during read discards the returned screen
ambiguous completion mention is not replayed after observer reconstruction
mismatched receipt fingerprint cannot repair Gateway acceptance or finish an unknown card
failed Gateway receipt persistence keeps the recovery obligation retryable without sending
runtime observation follows working to idle while keeping a non-native outcome
a confirmed started flag allows an observed fast idle without inventing a turn
runtime blocked is not a terminal task result
runtime unknown is not a terminal task result
runtime exited is reported as process evidence
runtime error is reported as process evidence
a crash with a writing intent resumes observation but never resends input
a live handoff cannot be finalized as idle while its acknowledgement is pending
offline observation keeps the same obligation for reconnect
binding revocation stops reads without stopping a remote task
changed incarnation cannot inherit old terminal output
changed cwd cannot inherit old terminal output
changed machine cannot inherit old terminal output
observer close is read-only and leaves durable work for the next process
proven not-sent input does not start terminal observation
corrupt observation journals are rejected and retained
terminal rendering escapes action fences, images, links, ANSI and controls
passive follow keeps an idle baseline then observes consecutive external runs without submitting
passive follow reconstruction and repeated on preserve one active presentation
follow off preserves pending input recovery and never converts it to a subscription
passive following yields to an input result instead of duplicating terminal output
terminal completion between passive and input reads does not create a second result card, restart=false
terminal completion between passive and input reads does not create a second result card, restart=true
stream off suppresses progress while preserving input outcome
passive follow reconnect records only fresh read evidence
a sequence change may reveal an offline terminal cycle but never manufactures a task result
unknown and unchanged idle states do not produce passive follow cards
passive idle counter changes never replay an unchanged screen, restart=false
passive idle counter changes never replay an unchanged screen, restart=true
legacy phase hashes seed a quiet baseline instead of replaying a historical completion
failed passive baseline reads do not advance evidence or create a card
passive baseline rejects permission changes during its read
passive baseline rejects incarnation changes during its read
passive baseline rejects reference changes during its read
an activity beginning during the quiet baseline read is followed immediately
a verified error transition during baseline capture remains visible
a verified exited transition during baseline capture remains visible
passive screen comparison ignores ANSI redraws and line ending changes
a fast unseen external completion still delivers with stream off
an input arriving during a passive baseline read owns the only result card
revoked passive follow stops without reading or announcing a task outcome
passive follow retires changed incarnation without reading the replacement
passive follow retires changed cwd without reading the replacement
passive follow retires changed machine without reading the replacement

turning passive follow off retires its existing card and keeps the external process alone
input priority retains ambiguous passive card evidence instead of resetting its handle
simultaneous synchronize waits for the original read instead of completing from a stale snapshot
terminal observations keep each accepted actor and chat attribution across reconstruction

another participant follows the same chat without replacing the original subscription authority

terminal tail maximizes escaped byte budget: 中🧪文中🧪文

terminal text retains commands, commentary, status and input without classification
overflow discards oldest characters and keeps latest end even for a single huge line

empty terminal and oversized trusted regions have explicit behavior

limits: The comparison detects only changes inside the existing normalized display window, not native turns.
Invisible fast tasks with identical output cannot be distinguished from repeated status reports.
Native IM visual rendering is not fully emulated by Markdown/parser tests.
